what: IDEX makes specialised pumps, valves and flow components through more than fifty separate businesses, each serving a narrow market: fire truck pumps, laboratory fluidics, industrial dispensing and sealing.
customers: Fire departments, life science and analytical instrument makers, industrial processors, and semiconductor and energy customers.
money: pumps, meters and flow components for industry
precision fluidics for laboratory and medical instruments
fire truck pumps, rescue tools and dispensing equipment
moat: Dozens of niche positions where it is the leading supplier to markets too small for large competitors to pursue, with components designed into customers' equipment.
risks: Industrial and life science instrument demand has been soft
Revenue has grown only about 3% a year over three years
Growth depends partly on continuing acquisitions
opportunities: Operating margin of 20% with a 45% gross margin
A long record of acquiring small niche manufacturers and raising their margins
watch: Organic order growth and performance in Health and Science Technologies.
